learning_extracted: H-replay-rule-state-mismatch is ELIMINATED at matched budget on the pre-registered bar. The hypothesis asserted the shared end-of-episode rule_state 'randomises the rule-attributable gradient BY CONSTRUCTION'; restoring every sample's own action-time rule_state (direction mismatch to the live state 0.50-0.70) moved pooled persistence by +0.018 +/- 0.019 (t(4) = 0.93 against zero), 0/5 seeds against margins of 0.069-0.077 that sit at 25 percent of the in-run bracket (0.27-0.31). The mean lift is 2.8 SE below the margin (paired per-seed t(4) = -2.73, p = 0.026 one-sided); an effect at ~0.7x the margin is not excluded. A by-construction randomisation would have recovered a large fraction of the bracket; it recovered ~6 percent.

The structure the data DO show is the driver's own pre-registered non-credit route: first-layer RULE-input-column persistence rises by +0.07 to +0.17 on 4/5 seeds (0.403->0.576, 0.477->0.549, 0.448->0.526, 0.474->0.548) while SUMMARY-input columns stay flat (-0.012..+0.048). With one shared rule_state every sample's rule-column gradient is collinear within an update; per-sample rule_state breaks that collinearity and makes the rule columns' steps more consistent WITHOUT making the head's credit more correct. The queue-time red-team F3 fix (C1 also requires a summary-column rise) is exactly what kept this from being read as support.

Seed 622's lift (0.0695) misses its margin (0.0701) by 0.0006 and seed 644 (0.0551) by 0.013; both carry summary-column rises (+0.003, +0.048). Three seeds are null or negative. Recorded so the null is not overstated: a small positive effect confined to two seeds is compatible with the data, but it is not the 'material' lift the leg predicted and it does not reach the pre-registered majority under any reading.

1027 independently REPRODUCES 1020's C2 persistence-low reading: against the 1020 midpoint (floor + ceiling)/2 = 0.586-0.603, seeds 622/633/644 sit below in BOTH arms (FAITHFUL 0.406/0.558/0.481; OWN 0.475/0.559/0.537) and seeds 611/655 above in both -- the identical 3-of-5 on the identical seeds as 1020, now with the replay rule_state mismatch controlled. The persistence-low majority is robust to the credit path (discharging the C2 clause of the open 1020 failure_record target), and its landing on the SAME three seeds across two independent experiments makes SEED IDENTITY, not the credit path, the candidate explanatory variable -- a confound any successor's per-seed design must pre-register against (fresh seeds alongside these five).

Within 1027 alone, the TRAINED heads measurably diverge across arms (fresh-select flips 84/373 vs 70/373 on seed 644, 19/186 vs 13/186 on seed 622, 6/200 vs 9/200 on 611) across 70 online P1 episodes, while per-episode returns are bit-identical and the P1 buffers SHA-256-identical on 5/5 seeds. This is a within-1027, trained-head demonstration that the readout's output had no behavioural consequence during training -- independent of 1029's init-head measurement and covering the trained-head magnitude regime 1029 did not run.

The deeper reason the credit-assignment fix could not matter comes from the cluster: with modulatory selection authority OFF the readout's output was empirically inert at selection (1029: 0/1694 argmin, 0/13857 sampled actions; a magnitude fact, since the bias is applied as-is and at x50 it does move the argmin on 31/1694), so there was no consequence-credit for the per-sample rule_state to bind. The P1 surrogate log_softmax(-bias) x advantage with the action chosen by E3 is, to measurement precision, advantage-weighted imitation of E3; imitation credit is bound to (summaries, selected action, episode advantage) and is indifferent to which rule_state the head is conditioned on beyond input structure -- which is the signature observed.

Positive-negative result for the dependency: the biological triage's eligibility-trace analogue was correctly aimed, and its null is what three-factor plasticity predicts when the synapse under study did not participate in the action. The FAIL supports the dependency 'a trained readout must gate selection for outcome-based learning to shape it' (sd_082 design doc: 'selection without a trained read-out to action is inert') rather than weakening anything.

learning_extracted: H-selection-authority-bounded is CONFIRMED, quantitatively. At native magnitude the init-head rule readout (|bias| 0.0037-0.040 against a raw E3 score range of 2.85-66.6, ratio 0.0004-0.0040) changes E3's argmin on 0 of 1694 raw-identical co-fresh ticks and the sampled action on 0 of 13857 ticks across 5 seeds; under authority it changes the argmin on 1.4-26 percent (4/5 seeds clear 0.02). The 1020 autopsy's learning 5.1 ('any behavioural probe on this path is inert until selection authority is enabled') is now a measurement, not an inference from config.py's comment -- and it is a MAGNITUDE fact, not a structural one: the bias is applied as-is with authority OFF (e3_selector.py:3390) and at x50 the whole readout does move the argmin on 31/1694 ticks.

The magnitude sub-question is CLOSED FROM ABOVE by the substrate. The tanh bounds |bias| < bias_scale = 0.1 (lateral_pfc_analog.py:154, :479-481), so a realisable SD-082 head has 2.5x-27x headroom over native; MAG x50 (applied after the bound) tested 1.8x-20x beyond that and the rule-attributable part still moved the argmin on only 6/1694. Within the bound, magnitude alone cannot suffice -- exactly the hypothesis's content. The driver's 'magnitude_test_underpowered' suffix is correct relative to authority's realised factor (72-6543, median 2040) and should be read as 'under-set vs authority, over-powered vs the substrate'. No measurement-debt is owed; a successor magnitude arm at authority's factor (|bias| 0.27-262) could not bear on SD-082.

The binding quantity is the readout's magnitude relative to the primary score range, and the raw E3 score range varies 23x across seeds (2.85 to 66.6), so a fixed-magnitude readout's inertness is seed-dependent -- which is what the substrate's authority device (rescale to gain x range) exists to normalise.

Authority is a blunt instrument. It rescales the WHOLE modulatory composite to 50 percent of the raw range by one scalar (realised factor 72-6543 per seed), and authority ON vs OFF by itself changes E3's top preference on 34-81 percent of ticks. The rule-attributable part of that is 1.4-26 percent of argmin decisions and 0-7.5 percent of sampled actions; the rest is the random-init gated_policy bias and any other co-summed channel. Any successor that reads behaviour under authority must ablate or record the co-summed channels, or its 'readout effect' is mostly gated_policy. Recording gap for successors: per-channel modulatory composition per tick (the scale factor IS recorded).

Cluster-level, and the most consequential finding: the lineage's P1 REINFORCE surrogate is log_softmax(-bias / T) over the head's OWN output with the action chosen by E3 (x1020._reinforce_step, driver:656-658; the substrate exposes only bias_head_parameters() -- no substrate-side caller exists, the loop is driver-owned). With the readout empirically inert at selection, the return is to measurement precision independent of the head's output, so the gradient is advantage-weighted imitation of E3's selections rather than reinforcement of the head's consequences. Every P1 run in 822f/1020/1027/1028 trained an imitator. SD-082's design doc names the intended regime ('(b) reinforcement-style gradient from E3 action outcomes'; 'selection without a trained read-out to action is inert'); no run WITH THE SD-082 CONSUMER ENGAGED (rule_readout_consumer=True) has yet trained the readout in it. (~50 ARC-062/GAP-B-lineage drivers train the pre-SD-082 hard-clamp head under authority gain 2.0 -- the successor's GOV-REUSE-1 prior art, see successor_experiment_recommendation.)

Read-across for V3-EXQ-1028 (running), CONFIRMING its pre-registration rather than correcting it: 1028's driver already states (lines 90-93, 110-112) that with authority OFF 'the head's bias never changes a committed action ... 1029 measures it' and that its C3 statistic is 'Correlational by construction at authority OFF ... which is what the hypothesis asserts'. 1029 supplies the measurement 1028 deferred to (0/1694 argmin, 0/13857 sampled actions), which is what licenses 1028's frozen-init-head flip labelling on every episode. Recorded here, NOT adjudicated (1028's autopsy owns it).

E3 never commits in this configuration (committed_fraction 0.0 on every runner, 5 seeds x 8 runners) -- every behavioural selection is a multinomial draw at temperature 1.0. The argmin DV is the right one (red-team F1 at queue time), and the sampled-action divergence (0-7.5 percent under authority) is the behavioural consequence a successor should expect to be small unless commitment is also engaged.

cluster_pattern.shape: Two legs of one GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1020_2026-09-11, qid sd082_candidate_discriminating_readout_locus): the credit-assignment rival (1027, process family) returns an informative null at matched budget while the intrinsic-architecture leg (1029, constitution family) confirms that the readout is causally inert at selection without authority. Read together they locate the binding constraint UPSTREAM of credit assignment and upstream of the learning-signal legs: the readout's non-participation in selection.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: In the 822f/1020/1027/1028 training configuration (modulatory selection authority OFF) the rule->bias readout's output is empirically inert at E3's selection -- 0/1694 argmin changes and 0/13857 sampled-action changes at native magnitude (1029), and within 1027 diverging trained heads left per-episode returns bit-identical on 5/5 seeds. This is a MAGNITUDE fact (the bias is applied as-is; at x50 it moves the argmin on 31/1694), not a structural absence. To measurement precision the lineage's REINFORCE surrogate (log_softmax over the head's own bias, action chosen by E3, per-episode scalar advantage) is therefore advantage-weighted imitation of E3, not consequence-based reinforcement. The credit-assignment fix (1027) could not matter because there was no measurable consequence-credit to mis-assign; the learning-signal legs (1020/1028) measure the consistency of an imitation gradient, not of the reinforcement SD-082's design names. The binding constraint is a configuration/training-regime property of the whole lineage, not a substrate ceiling and not a defect in any one driver.
readings: training_regime_causally_inert -- the readout was trained without participating in selection (design implication: P1 under authority ON with co-summed channels controlled)
authority_channel_confound -- authority amplifies the whole modulatory composite; a behavioural readout under authority is mostly gated_policy unless controlled
